name: AP-66 Campomanes–León (Aucalsa)
law: The Ministry of Transport's tolls in force from 2025-01-01 on the AP-66 Campomanes–León (Aucalsa), by pair of stations either way: Pesados 1 (two or three axles) and Pesados 2 (four axles or more), excluding 21% IVA. Stations placed at the concessionaire's own map of its toll plazas and accesses.

sources.title: Ministerio de Transportes: peajes vigentes en la AP-66 CAMPOMANES - LEON (2025)
